## Download

| Your computer | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 | `FigTime-…-windows.exe` (the app itself — no installer) |
| Mac (Apple chip or Intel) | `FigTime-…-mac.dmg` |

**First launch:** FigTime isn't code-signed yet, so your system will warn you once.
- **Windows:** on "Windows protected your PC", click **More info → Run anyway**.
- **Mac:** if it says FigTime can't be opened, go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**.

**Upgrading from 1.x?** Uninstall the old version first (Windows → Settings → Apps → Figtime → Uninstall).

See the [README](https://github.com/krutikkkkkkkkk/FigTime#readme) for full setup steps.
